crew.overview: Bobby Griffith was his mother's favorite son, the perfect all-American boy growing up under deeply religious influences in Walnut Creek, California. Bobby was also gay. Struggling with a conflict no one knew of, much less understood, Bobby finally came out to his family.
crew.title: Prayers for Bobby

details.biography: Katie Ford is co-Creator and Executive Producer for AppleTV's comedy High Desert starring Patricia Arquette, Brad Garrett and Matt Dillon. Katie has written for both TV and film and is best known for writing the film Miss Congeniality. She started as a stand up comic in Toronto and a playwright in Toronto and LA. From IMDB
details.name: Katie Ford
